newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Recor says in talks with bankers on debt.
newsitem.headline: Recor says in talks with bankers on debt.

text.p: Audio product and television maker Recor Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was continuing discussions with bankers concerning its debt position and its shares would remain suspended pending further announcement.

Trading of the company's shares have been suspended since August 23 in view of the fundamental uncertainties relating to the availability of further banking facilities from its bankers, and its ability of retain land-use rights and complete development of certain properties in China, Recor said.
Recor's chairman James Hon said the company was "continuing confidential discussions with its bankers...No binding agreements have yet been entered..."
Hon also said the company had reached agreement with Chinese authorities on amendments to its land-use rights but a decision on details of the properties development might be deferred.
Last month, Recor posted a net loss of HK$124.79 million for the year ended March 31, 1996.
